meaning: Existing source names remain unchanged. Terminology and identifiers below are stable within v1; later changes require a versioned v2 migration and operator review.

terms.name: Research Rulefield
terms.definition: Researchable question-space containing hypotheses, source claims, potentially incompatible rules, observers and assays.

terms.name: Executable or Declarative Rule
terms.definition: A concrete typed predicate, local transformation, guard or admissible transition with explicit semantic scope and a falsifier.

terms.name: Research Priority Position
terms.definition: Operator attention order; neither scientific strength nor semantic ontology.

terms.name: Rulefield Submission Request
terms.definition: Human-original expressions and preferences; no automatic code or source permission.

terms.name: Rulefield Amendment Packet
terms.definition: Machine-typed amendment proposal using the existing receiver; not automatically adopted.

terms.name: Pre-Synthesis Disclosure
terms.definition: Full-known-information disclosure with complete packet and review; current engine retains its existing schema.

terms.name: Rulefield Operator Docket
terms.definition: Content-bound operator-facing review of one specific research proposal revision; machine-complete source, scannable in chat.

terms.name: Operator Decision Statement
terms.definition: Actual human turn, bound to docket and decision scope; the assistant never self-authenticates it.

terms.name: Staged Synthesis Candidate
terms.definition: Noncanonical reviewable implementation following separately authorized source-free staging.

terms.name: Rulefield Handoff Bundle
terms.definition: Exact-head ZIP with source manifest and supporting tests, not an automatically live connection.

decisions.human_confirmation: GenUI.issueNewTurn or clear human message is a new conversation turn; it is not a direct GitHub/registry mutation.
decisions.versioning: Never rename an already issued ID. Any later terminology change requires a new version and explicit migration ledger.
